title: Dadista · Objeto encontrado
description: Dadista's level 6 (docs/animas/dadaista/README.md § The hand's size): with Aitor's hand of dice full, Gerard's fire on a wet dog makes Vapor, a reaction, and Objeto encontrado deals Aitor a die past the top; the tray shows it with the astral's bluish-white rim. Then a hand of six, and Defender, which takes none of it off. Fight tester, Gerard in Matemágico, Aitor in Dadista at level 6, three sturdy wet dogs. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.turn = id => document.querySelector('#battle .turn-meta')?.textContent === 'TU TURNO' && document.querySelector('.battle-dock[data-dock="1"]')?.dataset.member === id; ui.tweak(s => s.foes.forEach(f => { f.hp = f.maxHp = 900; }));

ui.tweak(s => { s.foes.forEach(f => { f.timed = { ...f.timed, mojado: { level: 1, left: 20, next: 20 } }; }); const a = s.allies.find(x => x.id === 'aitor'); a.dice = ['mano', 'ojo', 'tijeras', 'corchete', 'mano']; a.secondary = a.maxSecondary; s.allies.find(x => x.id === 'gerard').element = 'fuego'; });

steps.caption: Aitor's hand at its top: five dice (level 4 and the jar's Maná +1). The dogs are wet
Gerard's fire on a wet dog: ¡Vapor!, a reaction. Over Aitor, «Objeto encontrado · Pasiva · +1 dado», and a sixth die in his tray
The sixth die, past the top, with the astral's bluish-white rim; the plate's pips show it too
Defender with a hand of six: no maná comes and no die goes; the six stay
